en_title: GTA 6 Triggers Busiest Traffic Day in Comcast History
opus_summary: Comcast表示，《GTA6》预载使其迎来自1963年成立以来流量最高的一天，峰值流量比此前纪录高出9.6%。该公司称，网络历史上流量最高的十天中有五天与《GTA6》有关，高峰时段24%的互联网流量来自下载和游玩该游戏的用户。

paragraphs.en: Comcast has said GTA 6 's launch triggered the busiest traffic day the company has seen since it was founded in 1963.
paragraphs.cn: Comcast表示，《GTA 6》的推出促成了该公司自1963年成立以来流量最高的一天。

paragraphs.en: The latest record broken by Rockstar Games' latest actually comes from one of the biggest media and technology companies in the United States. After previously reporting that Grand Theft Auto had led to a 4x increase in traffic on Xbox consoles November 18, Comcast has now confirmed that pre-loads for the day resulted in the busiest day it has ever seen – and it wasn't close.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar最新作品打破的最新纪录，实际上来自美国最大的媒体和科技公司之一。Comcast此前报告称，《侠盗猎车手》使11月18日XBOX主机上的流量增长了4倍，如今该公司证实，当天的预载让其迎来了有史以来流量最高的一天，而且远超以往纪录。

paragraphs.en: Comcast recorded peak traffic 31% higher than the average day and 9.6% higher than the previous record holder. Moreover, GTA 6 has resulted in five out of 10 of the busiest days the network has ever seen. Even more remarkable is the news that, as reported by Comcast, 24% of all of its internet traffic during peak times was from users downloading and playing the game.
paragraphs.cn: Comcast记录到的峰值流量比平日高出31%，比此前的纪录高出9.6%。此外，该网络有史以来流量最高的10天中，有5天是由《GTA 6》促成的。更惊人的是，Comcast报告称，其高峰时段全部互联网流量的24%来自下载和游玩这款游戏的用户。

paragraphs.en: If Rockstar fans weren't playing GTA 6, they were watching it. Twitch traffic increased by almost 50% on November 18 and is continuing to rise in the days following that launch. GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, but thanks to the New Zealand trick , a massive chunk of players actually took their trip to Leonida hours early. It certainly helped boost traffic across the board, and in Comcast's case, it resulted in its busiest day ever.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的粉丝即使没有在玩《GTA 6》，也在观看别人玩这款游戏。Twitch流量在11月18日增长了近50%，并在游戏推出后的几天里持续上升。《GTA 6》于11月19日在PS5和XBOX Series上推出，但借助新西兰技巧，大批玩家实际上提前数小时踏上了前往Leonida的旅程。这无疑推动了各方面流量的增长，而对Comcast来说，这促成了其有史以来流量最高的一天。

paragraphs.en: To put some of these numbers into perspective, the company shared a very relevant measurement. November 18 traffic generated on PlayStation and Xbox alone delivered enough data for one million homes to stream The Odyssey in 4K… for two days straight.
paragraphs.cn: 为了让人们更直观地理解其中一些数字，该公司分享了一个非常贴切的衡量标准。仅11月18日PlayStation和XBOX产生的流量所传输的数据，就足够100万户家庭以4K画质在线播放《奥德赛》……连续播放两天。

paragraphs.en: It's shocking to see how GTA 6 affected Comcast, but then again, we've known Rockstar's new game would be a juggernaut when it eventually launched. The developer's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, reported that it had earned an unbelievable $3.79 billion in the first day after its release. That makes it not just the biggest video game launch of all time, but the biggest entertainment launch across any medium .
paragraphs.cn: 看到《GTA 6》对Comcast产生的影响令人震惊，但话说回来，我们早就知道Rockstar的新游戏最终推出时将势不可挡。开发商的母公司Take-Two Interactive报告称，该游戏在发售后的第一天就获得了令人难以置信的37.9亿美元收入。这不仅使其成为有史以来规模最大的视频游戏首发，也成为所有媒介中规模最大的娱乐作品首发。

paragraphs.en: Critics everywhere helped GTA 6 earn the title of highest-rated game of all time . IGN was included in that list after delivering a 10/10 review . We said, "Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
paragraphs.cn: 各地评论家帮助《GTA 6》赢得了有史以来评分最高游戏的称号。IGN也在其中，给出了10/10的评价。我们写道：「细节精致入微，处处可供无尽探索，设计上一丝不苟，《GTA 6》是我玩过的最令人印象深刻的一款电子游戏。」

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？来看看IGN上的《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过第1章指南与提示以及第2章指南与提示了解前几章的全部详情。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
